Name: Katie Cornine
Badge: Reading to Write: Say-Mean-Matter
How might you introduce Say-Mean-Matter to your students? What about this framework do you think will be helpful for them? What might be challenging?:

I would use this strategy in my small title reading groups. We would use it with the text students are already reading in my groups. I like that this strategy can be applied to many texts that I am already using in my groups. I would use the attached poster that I created on Canva to help remind students of each of the steps. The mean step of this strategy will help my ELLs with the meaning of the text. Overall, our scores on testing indicate that our students across the board struggle with vocabulary, so I think this strategy would help reinforce these students' vocabulary. The matter part of this strategy will help students think deeply about the text and make connections.

Upload an example you’ve created to try out They Say/I Say or Say-Mean-Matter with your students. This could be a handout or chart, a text plus directions for guiding students through the process, or a sample notebook/annotation page that models how the routine might look in practice.:
